messages:
maria: Quick sync: KeyBridge (SI) + LockForge (HSM vendor) want a joint marketplace listing + press coord. Target week of 2025-06-09. Need SAML/SCIM path + KMS integration checklist. Who volunteers to draft the partner-runbook?
devin: I can draft the runbook. will need a staging HSM endpoint and SAML metadata from vendor.
yasmin: security flag 120: must validate remote-attestation and CMK import flow. I'll write the attestation test cases.
marco: marketplace note: listing needs 1 short blurb, 3 feature bullets, logos (svg/png), and a short 2-min demo gif. I can draft copy once we have feature list.
olga: sales asks for a "how it works" diagram and an FAQ about key custody and rotation.
keybridge-poc: vendor here. we'll hand over SAML metadata, SCIM test tenant, and an HSM staging host. uploading to partner bucket now.
maria: great, please include a staging cert and a sample provisioning CSV for SCIM users.
keybridge-poc: adding cert + sample.csv to partner-share.
devin: quick tech checklist proposal:
- SAML: metadata import, SP-initiated flow, attribute mapping for email+uid+groups
- SCIM: create/update/delete, pagination + bulk patch safety
- KMS/HSM: wrap/unwrap with customer keys, import verification, rotate keys + test decrypt after rotation
- Secrets sync: TTL behavior, cached secrets invalidation on rotate
- Telemetry: metric hooks + audit event format
- E2E: staging smoke w/ 30 users and two apps

yasmin: add incident playbook: revoke CMK -> audit trail -> notify customers. Also include firmware attestation check.
devin: here's the SAML mapping we validated:```
{
  "uid": "urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.1",
  "email": "urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3",
  "displayName": "urn:oid:2.5.4.3",
  "groups": "urn:oid:1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941"
}
```
marco: embargo request? Legal will want an embargo window.
legal-sarah: request embargo until 2025-06-12 20:00 PT. also need review of vendor logos and trademark usage.
maria: noted. we'll plan announcement for 2025-06-12 20:15 PT (marketplace goes live then).
olga: deadline for sales collateral: 2025-06-10 COB.
keybridge-poc: confirming asset drop: logos, screenshots, demo gif uploaded.
infra-bot: CI: redwood/keybridge-integration branch deploy successful (build #512).
devin: I'll post the initial runbook link here by EOD tomorrow. can folks ack owners?
yasmin: I'll own attestation + security test harness.
marco: I'll own marketplace copy + demo.
olga: I'll own sales collateral + diagram.
maria: i'll coordinate the launch timeline and partner comms.
legal-sarah: I'll sign off on legal docs and embargo wording.
keybridge-poc: vendor will own staging certs and HSM test credentials.
maria: action list recap:
- devin: runbook + staging test (due: tomorrow)
- yasmin: attestation tests + incident playbook (due: Thu)
- marco: marketplace copy + demo (due: Fri)
- olga: sales collateral + diagram (due: Mon)
- legal-sarah: embargo/legal sign-off (due: Mon)
- keybridge-poc: staging certs + creds (done: uploaded)
All: react with :white_check_mark: when you take ownership.
devin: :white_check_mark:
yasmin: :white_check_mark:
marco: :white_check_mark:
olga: :white_check_mark:
legal-sarah: :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks everyone. I'll open a short Wed AM sync if any blockers. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for status updates.
